fidelity: F2a — Simplified ADM1-style Biochemical Kinetics + Lumped Thermal ODE
source: Batstone et al. (2002) ADM1, Water Sci. Technol. 45(10):65; Angelidaki et al. (1993) Biotechnol. Bioeng. 42:159; Angelidaki et al. (2009) Water Sci. Technol. 59(5):927; Donoso-Bravo et al. (2011) Water Res. 45:5347

unit.name: Generic Thermophilic CSTR Anaerobic Digester — Physics-Lumped (3-step Monod)

k_hyd.note: First-order hydrolysis disintegration rate of particulate substrate (thermophilic, Batstone 2002 / Donoso-Bravo 2011)

mu_max_aci.note: Max specific growth rate of acidogens (thermophilic, faster than mesophilic ~3)

Ks_aci.note: Monod half-saturation for soluble sugars/amino acids -> VFA (acidogenesis)

mu_max_met.note: Max specific growth rate of methanogens (thermophilic acetoclastic, Angelidaki 1993)

Y_met.note: Biomass yield coefficient for methanogens (low, slow growers)

KI_vfa.note: Non-competitive VFA self-inhibition constant for methanogens (acidification protection)

f_ch4_cod.note: Theoretical CH4 yield per kg COD removed at STP (0.35 m3/kgCOD, Batstone 2002)

CH4_fraction.note: Methane volume fraction in biogas (thermophilic typical 0.6-0.7)

LHV_methane_kWh_m3.note: Lower heating value of methane (35.8 MJ/m3)

UA_loss.note: Overall heat-loss conductance (wall U*A) to ambient
